page.layout: One printed page. Running head "INDEX" at the top. Below it one column of index entries, each line with the name at left and its "cap." reference at right, grouped under the letter headings R., S., T. and V. No margin notes. Show-through from the other side (faint mirrored text at the lower right and left) is not transcribed.
page.notes: The last line "CATA-" is a word broken at the foot of the page and continued on the next page; it is set in larger spaced capitals. Faint mirrored entries ("Quartadecimani", "Quintiliani") at the lower right and faint marks at the lower left are show-through from the reverse side and are not transcribed. No page number is printed. Spelling of "Samosateniani" and "Theopaschitæ" follows the printed long-s forms, which were read as s. The "cap." numerals were read from a scan with some wear; the figure in "Seueriani" (xxiiij) and "Samseitæ" (xxxij) are the least certain readings.
